channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jonas Jerebko | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jonas Jerebko from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jonas Jerebko
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Jonas Jerebko:

“We're really lucky to have gotten him. I think he's going to play a big role for us.”

Steve Kerr on Jonas Jerebko, Sep 29, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jonas Jerebko
item.description:
Jay King:Brad Stevens on the forgotten Jonas Jerebko:

“I told him last night, there's a good chance that he'll be a big part of this.”

Brad Stevens on Jonas Jerebko, May 18, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jonas Jerebko
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Brad Stevens on winter weather woes:

“I heard it's [Winter] Storm Jonas, is that right? There [Jerebko] goes. The Swedish Larry Bird.”

Brad Stevens on Jonas Jerebko, Jan 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @ESPNForsberg.
